newsitem.title: USA: Guaranty National chairman Gruber dies.
newsitem.headline: Guaranty National chairman Gruber dies.

text.p: Guaranty National Corp said on Friday chairman Alan R. Gruber, 69, died of complications following surgery for brain cancer and has been succeeded by W. Marston Becker.

Gruber had recently retired as chairman and chief executive officer of Orion Capital Corp, which owns 81 percent of Guaranty National. At the time of his death, Gruber was chairman of the executive and investment committees of Orion's board.
Becker had been scheduled to assume the post of chairman of Guaranty in May, the company said in a statement.
Becker is chairman and chief executive of Orion and has served as a director at Guaranty National since July 1996, it said.
Guaranty National offers commercial and private passenger automobile insurance through its subsidiaries. Friday, 18 April 1997 15:29:32 ENDS nN1891214
